$Comment: A second Sawmill for a worker who has proven the first one earns its keep: a thousand pieces
of lumber milled, then sap delivered.
The volume step counts every cut of every species the mill hands over ('Wood_' on PREFIX,
qualified to the Sawmill) and carries the shared mill_lumber TextKey; bring_sap is Order 2, an
exact-id hand-in to Marn. Tree sap is a Sawmill byproduct, so the delivery is paid for by
running the mill, not by a detour. This quest branches off the chain after Reading the Grain
rather than sitting in it, so it carries no Chains entry and its SortOrder places it after the
chain's rungs. The reward is the mill itself; remove that entry and the quest is a plain XP job.
Name: Second_Bench
